title: Senate Approval & Notification of 13th Annual Convocation (XIII Convocation)
summary: The 13th Convocation of NIT Patna was held on December 28, 2024. Shri Arun Kumar Singh (Chairman & CEO, ONGC) addressed the batch as Chief Guest.

title: Conferral of Medals & President's Gold Medal Notification
summary: Official notification of 18 Gold Medalists for the XIII Convocation, including President's Gold Medalist Mahi (Civil Engineering).

title: Procedure for Dispatch of Degree Certificates in Absentia
summary: Graduates unable to attend the XIII Convocation in person can submit their postal address along with the requisite fee receipt for dispatch of degree certificate via Speed Post.
